notes.title: Kickstarter is Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38344724/8921e0976123919fe9c772e3894c88011fe83f75.jpg[/img]

Battle Royale: For Your Heart is now available to back on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/827156618/battle-royale-for-your-heart]Kickstarter![/url] 

Help us make the full game a reality by pledging. You can obtain rewards such as backer only updates, a copy of the game, early access game builds, your very own character, and more! 


Not convinced? Go ahead and give our extended demo a download. It features 60k words (2-3 hours of playtime), partial voice acting, 3 duo partners and 3 more romance options. Plus, you can choose your avatar's gender, voice, weapon loadout and more! 


Thank you for taking a look at our game, and consider backing us or sharing the link to our kickstarter to spread the word.
